names.note: The nominative the day page's own `/name/9682.html` link carries in its `title`, «Михаил (Дейнека), иерей, сщмч.», with the two trailing rank words left off; the surname in parentheses is part of the name and stays. The day's line prints «Михаила» twice — once among the presbyters, which is this folder, and once at the end as «мч. Михаила», the layman, whose name link is 9997. `fk.mjs` on this form returned NONE before the write.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 19 мая ст. ст., which is the year for all fourteen people that line names. His name page gives no year at all and no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Антония , еп. Белгородского, и с ним Митрофана , Александра , Михаила , Ипполита , Николая , Василия , Николая , Максима , Александра , Павла , Павла , Георгия пресвитеров и мч. Михаила (1938).»

attestations.note: Third of the thirteen named «и с ним» after the bishop of Belgorod, and **the first of the line's two Michaels**: he stands inside the run of forenames the line's «пресвитеров» covers, while the second Michael stands after it as «мч. Михаила», a layman, with his own name link. The two are told apart by the links, 9682 and 9997, and by the grade. **The line and the name link are all there is**: 9682 is a heading, the grade and two days, with no narrative. azbyka.ru was not read.
